# Kerala SEC Voter List Extraction API - Workspace Instructions

This is a Node.js Express backend with Playwright automation for extracting voter list data from the Kerala State Election Commission portal.

## Project Stack
- **Backend**: Node.js with Express
- **Automation**: Playwright (headless Chromium)
- **Parsing**: Cheerio for HTML parsing
- **Frontend**: Vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript

## Architecture
- MVC pattern with controllers for dropdown data and voter extraction
- Headless browser automation for form submission and data extraction
- Manual captcha handling via user input
